evidence.title: SANE: State Anomaly Neutralization for Stable Extreme-Context Delta-Rule Models

summary: A new technique called State Anomaly Neutralization (SANE) aims to improve the stability of AI models operating under extreme contextual conditions. The approach focuses on delta-rule models to mitigate anomalies and enhance performance.
title: Researchers Introduce SANE: A New Method for Stabilizing AI Models in Extreme Contexts
